verdict.rationale: Docs show unified billing/analytics ("aggregate their billing in one place and keep track of all of their usage using our analytics"), per-key management with limits/expiry, and workspace-level budgets, and community confirms per-key limits and billing caps in practice (openrouter-comm-11, openrouter-comm-12). However there is no explicit documentation of a dashboard breaking spend down simultaneously by model, key, team, and user in one unified view. Missing for 10: explicit per-model spend reporting, per-user attribution within a team/workspace, and a documented unified cost-analytics dashboard screenshot/example.
